purpose: Controlled place identities only. geography answers 'which place participates in a supported relationship?'. It is distinct from language (de != Germany).
rules: This registry identifies controlled PLACES only.
The existence of a place is NOT an evidentiary claim.
Evidence qualification belongs to relationship INSTANCES (relationship_class_registry + evidence records), NEVER to a geography record.
A geography record MUST NOT carry any relationship/evidence-status field.
Germany, Morocco, China, Gulf states etc. exist as places regardless of whether BISULFID holds any evidence about them.

geographies.label: GCC member states
geographies.note: Exactly the six Gulf Cooperation Council member states. Renamed from GEO-GULF (vocabulary integrity, concept-lexeme-resolution sprint): a broader 'Gulf region' geographic scope, if ever needed, will be defined as a separate governed object with its own explicit scope, not silently equated to GCC membership.
